name: グリフィスツー@skeb募集中
description:
不具合でグリフィスからツーになった。機械音痴で本アカ @jtlJ8NqvyjVufeQ に帰れなかった獣。🐀ﾗｯﾄ大好きお絵描き犬🐕‍だ。skebもよろしく。
描くのが好きなジャンル:生物、動物、骨、🐀、人獣、ロボットなど

資格:山菜ソムリエ🌱歯科技工士🦷

works.body:
I would like to have a rat (male) that looks like a pattern of my child.
I would like to make a personalized badge, so I would be happy if the composition is round.

https://twitter.com/EBIMUITA/status/1631297020878114826?t=JkYwJNaffO0_fLUMhspdDg&s=19

It's been a long time. I am Sirene, and I asked you to draw an illustration of Harpy a long time ago.
This time, I would like to ask you to draw Musht, the animal avatar I use on VRSNS called VRChat.

The overall image I would like is that of a disturbed animal in an unsafe street corner or back alley. (This is just an image of the atmosphere, so I'll leave it up to you to decide on the background.)
I don't have a specific pose or anything, but I would be happy if he has an evil look in his eyes and expression.

He should be holding a paper cigarette in his right hand, have a scar over his left eye and no highlights in his eye.
He is wearing a camouflage shirt with a woodland pattern, but you can rearrange it to some extent if it is difficult to draw.

The proportions are not specified, so you are free to draw as you like.
You can choose to draw it in a characteristic or realistic way, whichever you prefer. We would like to see either one, so please feel free to choose whichever you prefer.

https://twitter.com/SireneSonCat/status/1513346645253304322

My name is Zhu Neko. I'd like to make a request.

I'd like to ask you to draw Kish, a girl with cat ears, and a mouse.
I'll leave the composition to you.

https://mobile.twitter.com/syuneko_otonasi/status/1197428601206890497

Nice to meet you. If you don't mind, please take one.
FINAL FANTASY XI, a.k.a. FF11's Aello, a Harpiea monster. In short, I'd like an illustration of a harpie.
The large image is for drawing and the small image is for color reference.

As for the composition, I'd like to see them flying in the sky or grooming their feathers in a tree.
If possible, I would be happy if the content is recognizable as wildlife.
There are no restrictions on deformation, omission of details, facial expressions, poses, etc. However, please keep the design covered in feathers with no skin exposed except for the face and neck as shown in the materials.
I'd like to use it as a wallpaper for my PC, so a 16:9 ratio or similar size would be helpful.

https://xgf.nu/2GQj
